item.title: AI This AI That
item.description:
AI - Modern day drugs

I remember being excited hearing about this mystical “Aritifical Intelligence”. And 6 years later it has done irreparable damage to the software engineering field

i am sick and tired of seeing those purple-blueish themed websites with emojis and frosted elements.

Why a easy entry is a red flag

i remember reading in a book about how to choose a field to develop your business. the author talked about Entry which said that the harder it is to get into a field, the more leverage it has… if everyone can do it, theres no need. if not everyone can do it, everyone needs it.
